newsitem.title: UK: Britain's Natl Grid to float Energis-paper.
newsitem.headline: Britain's Natl Grid to float Energis-paper.

text.p: Energis Communications, part of Britain's National Grid Group Plc, plans a stock market flotation that would value it at 800 million pounds to 1.2 billion pounds ($1.3 to 1.9 billion), the Independent on Sunday reported.
National Grid was expected to sell a minority stake in Energis by the end of the year, the paper said.

"Flotation has always been one of the options for Energis. It has reached the position where it is an entirely realistic option," Peter Gavan, National Grid's director of corporate affairs, was quoted as saying.
However, the board had yet to approve the plan, the paper added.
